dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Was I like this before... Why did I want to wield my sword...

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Master... Senior... I...

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Alright! If you want to get your revenge, go on, then! Ahahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: What is the ultimate swordsmanship... Will defeating everyone make you the best in the world?

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: But the best in the world... if I am the best in the world...

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: If I am the best in the world, why am I so obsessed with the past?

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: And if I am not the best in the world, then master and the others have... for nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye...

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: What on earth was I thinking back then...

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Hello, if you want to become a disciple here, please... Ah, it's you, the Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: It has been a while. How has your journey through Inazuma gone?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You look a lot better now.

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Haha, once the knot in my heart came loose, I knew what to do next.

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Although I have lost my Vision and have no way of making my dream come true... I still have a group of disciples to succeed my will. The Meikyou Shisui Art will never be forgotten. There is still hope for our dream of being the best in the world.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Thank you! Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright...?

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Alright... alright? I'd be alright if I had good sword skills...

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: But my Vision...

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Without my Vision, I can no longer be the best in the world... All the things I did in the past would all... even my disciples will...

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Master, Senior... don't just stand there and watch, say something, please...!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You look much better now.

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Haha, once the knot in my heart came loose, I knew what to do next.

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Although my Vision has returned, I am not the person I was before... I will leave the dream of being the greatest swordmaster to my disciples.

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: As long as these young hopefuls are around, the Meikyou Shisui Art will never become lost to time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: May your wishes be granted as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: Haha, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: I've written down some of my experiences in swordsmanship that I've gleaned over the years. Though you aren't one of my disciples, I'm still indebted to you. Please accept it.

dialogues.speaker: Domon
dialogues.text: I wish you good fortunes in the long journey ahead of you.
